connector.name: Resy MCP
connector.registryDescription: Resy reservation management - search, book, cancel, favorites, and Priority Notify for Claude
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package resy-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chrischall account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RESY_EMAIL
env.description: Your Resy account email. Optional — leave unset to use the fetchproxy browser bridge instead.

env.name: RESY_PASSWORD
env.description: Your Resy account password. Optional — leave unset to use the fetchproxy browser bridge instead.

env.name: RESY_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Pre-obtained x-resy-auth-token. Overrides email/password and the fetchproxy bridge. Power users / CI only.

env.name: RESY_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
env.description: Set to '1' to disable the fetchproxy fallback (forces RESY_EMAIL+PASSWORD or RESY_AUTH_TOKEN).

env.name: RESY_API_KEY
env.description: Override the public web-app API key (rarely needed)
